test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution:
The erroneous spelling is '**Matriachy**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Among the given options, the incorrectly spelt word is '**Matriachy**'.
 
• Its correct spelling is '**Matriarchy**'. 
 
• It means **'a social system that gives power and control to women rather than men'.** (सामाजिक व्‍यवस्‍था जिसमें परिवार की सत्ता और नियंत्रण महिलाओं के अधीन होता है (न कि पुरुषों के पास), मातृ-सत्ता, मातृ-तंत्र)
 
 
• *Example: For 20 years, the country was ruled by a **matriarchy**. *
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the **meaning **of other words:

 
 
• **Mattress**: a large soft thing that you lie on to sleep, usually put on a bed. (गद्दा)
 
• **Matrix**: the cultural, social, or political environment in which something develops. (सांस्कृतिक, सामाजिक या राजनीतिक वातावरण जिसमें कुछ विकसित होता है)
 
• **Material**: a substance that can be used for making or doing something. (कुछ बनाने या कुछ करने के लिए प्रयुक्त पदार्थ, सामग्री, माल, सामान)
